description: The Health Statistics Report is the annual statistical publication of the Mauritius Ministry of Health and Wellness, produced by its Health Statistics Unit since 1975. According to the report page, it provides information on the state of health in the Republic of Mauritius, supports monitoring of population health, policy and programme evaluation and the ministry's key performance indicators, and supplies figures reported to the World Health Organization and for the Sustainable Development Goals. Reports from 2013 to 2024 are free to download as PDFs, and earlier editions are available from the unit on request. Caveats: the table contents could not be extracted here because of the PDF structure, so the exact tables are not listed; the reports are documents, not data files, and no licence is stated. Coverage is national. Simulation uses: baseline health service capacity and use for Mauritius in disaster and health system resilience studies. Related records: Healthsites.io (data-healthsites-io) gives open facility points for Mauritius to pair with these figures.
